name: PRISM 800m Meteorology Variables
description: Population-weighted ZCTA aggregations of PRISM 800-meter meteorological variables. PRISM (Parameter-elevation Regressions on Independent Slopes Model) provides gridded climate and weather estimates including temperature, precipitation, dew point temperature, vapor pressure deficit, and solar radiation. The pipeline aggregates daily PRISM rasters to census blocks and then applies Census block population weights to produce ZCTA-level daily and yearly files.

content.Missingness: 0 nulls across all meteorology value columns in daily and yearly parquet outputs

content.Data Source 1: PRISM Group, Oregon State University: https://prism.oregonstate.edu/ and https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/time_series/us/an/800m/
content.Data Source 2: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line block and ZCTA geographies: https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2010/TABBLOCK/ and https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2020/TABBLOCK20/
content.Data Source 3: U.S. Census Bureau decennial block and ZCTA population counts queried through tidycensus
content.Source citation: PRISM Group, Oregon State University, https://prism.oregonstate.edu/terms/
